scope: ENIGMA BRCA1/2 combined clinical likelihood ratios for PP4/BP5

target_specification.name: ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1/2 VCEP
target_specification.role: Defines PP4/BP5 LR thresholds and application rules

clinical_lr_data_release.name: UCSC ENIGMA BRCA1/BRCA2 likelihood for PP4 and BP5
clinical_lr_data_release.role: Provides variant-specific publisher-combined clinical LR values

combination_policy.runtime_input: Use the publisher-combined LR exactly as supplied by the pinned UCSC ENIGMA track.
combination_policy.publication_components: Retain for audit and display. Do not multiply them again in ARIANE.
combination_policy.criterion_assignment: Recalculate PP4/BP5 strength from combinedLR using ENIGMA VCEP v1.2 thresholds rather than trusting the rounded source label.
combination_policy.case_control_update: The source replaced the Parsons iCOGS case-control component with Zanti 2025 ccLR because the cohorts overlap.
combination_policy.source_caveat: UCSC reports that some residual overlap between Parsons 2019 and Easton 2007 may remain and recommends reviewing component values.

update_policy.recommended_check_cadence: monthly and before every ARIANE release
update_policy.update_detected_when: The remote BigBed SHA-256 differs from the pinned derived_from_bigbed_sha256.
required_before_activation: archive the downloaded candidate with source identity and checksum
review the UCSC dataVersion, changelog and build record
convert BigBed with the official UCSC tool and validate the declared schema
review added, removed and changed variant-level combined LR values
review every threshold crossing and every change of evidence direction
rebuild the derived snapshot and run the complete test suite
record expert approval and update the pinned manifest
update_policy.failure_behavior: Keep using the last checksum-validated release. Never activate a remote change automatically.
